# Win11 icon theme (vendored)

- Upstream: https://github.com/yeyushengfan258/Win11-icon-theme
- Commit: `a5b460a407da143b32f19a503d7fcebb3edf2371`
- Author: yeyushengfan258 (based on Ubuntu's Yaru icon theme, see `AUTHORS`)
- Licence: GPL-3.0 (`COPYING`)

Shipped unmodified so Lapin UX installs without downloading anything at
build time; only the preview screenshots (`View-*.png`) were left out. The
package installs it with its own `install.sh` (default colour, light and
dark variants) as the app, folder and file icons Lapin UX's icon themes
inherit from.
